import numpy as np
y=dP_dt
def test(name,cols):
    A=np.column_stack([np.ones_like(P)]+cols)
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(A,y,rcond=None)[0]
    r=y-A@c
    print(name, '%.3e'%(np.mean(r**2)/np.var(y)), np.round(c,4))
test('P,PlnP,P2',[P,P*np.log(P),P**2])
test('P,PlnP,sqrtP',[P,P*np.log(P),np.sqrt(P)])
test('P,P2,sqrtP',[P,P**2,np.sqrt(P)])
test('P,P2,lnP',[P,P**2,np.log(P)])
test('P,P2,P3,lnP',[P,P**2,P**3,np.log(P)])
test('P,P2,P3,P4',[P,P**2,P**3,P**4])
test('P,PlnP,P2,lnP',[P,P*np.log(P),P**2,np.log(P)])
test('P,P2,1/P',[P,P**2,1/P])
test('P,P2,P*exp(-P)',[P,P**2,P*np.exp(-P)])
test('P,P2,exp(-P)',[P,P**2,np.exp(-P)])
test('P,P2,exp(P)',[P,P**2,np.exp(P/3)])
